description: This script handles configuration and management of 3G network connections, including setup, teardown, and device handling. It defines functions for initializing configuration, setting up a 3G connection, and tearing down the connection, with several external script and command references.

methods.name: proto_3g_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for the 3G protocol, adding various string parameters for device, apn, service, pincode, delay, and dialnumber.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 3G connection based on parameters obtained via JSON, handles device file resolution, modem configuration commands, PIN code verification, and initiates the PPP connection.

methods.name: proto_3g_teardown
methods.description: Kills the 3G connection associated with the given interface.
